item.text: {"case_id":"SPR00408","decision":"candidate","candidate_ranking":["C09","C12","C20"],"selected_candidate_label":"C09","confidence":0.92,"relationship_type":"both","rationale":"C09 plausibly supplied a material drafting template for the child’s operative provisions. C12 and C20 share the week-observance structure and calls to officials and organizations, but their wording and sequence are less specifically aligned with the child.","shared_material":[{"child_excerpt":"do hereby designate the week beginning October 8, 1961, as Fire Prevention Week","parent_excerpt":"do proclaim the year 1960 as Visit the United States of America Year","explanation":"Both begin the operative section by formally designating a named observance period."},{"child_excerpt":"I urge State and local governments ... and business, labor and farm organizations, as well as schools, civic groups, and public information agencies, to observe Fire Prevention Week","parent_excerpt":"I request the appropriate officials of the Federal Government and of the several States, Territories, possessions, and municipalities ... to cooperate in the preparation for, and observance of, that year.
